newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index stable in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index stable in quiet trading.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse share index Semdex ended little changed on Wednesday, up 0.20 points to 322.32 in quiet trading with foreign investors seen buying stocks in the banking sector, bourse officials said.
Volume totalled 12.41 million rupees on 300,641 shares from 2.84 million rupees on 256,036 shares on Monday.
"It's been a quiet session and the high volumes in the banks' shares suggest foreign investors were behind," a broker said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 73 rupees on 78,856 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was stable at 8.40 rupees on 74,100 shares.
Most price levels in the rest of the market continued to remain little changed as a subdued mood persisted among local investors, dealers said.
Mauritius Breweries gained 2.0 rupees to 125 on 1,466 shares while Fincorp Investment remained at 71.50 rupees on 1,785 shares.
Investment stock Policy lost 10 cents to 3.40 rupees on 52,460 shares and Mauritius Development Investment Trust eased 10 cents to 7.20 rupees on 5,275 shares.
Sugar stocks Harel Freres shed 10 cents to 38.20 rupees on a heavy 26,730 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert was 20 cents higher to 31.80 rupees on 2,000 shares.
Conglomerate Rogers was unchanged at 94.50 rupees on 9,000 shares while oil concern Shell (Mauritius) fell 80 cents to 15.20 rupees on 4,000 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius climbed 50 cents to 53 rupees on 1,240 shares.
Debentures of Caudan Development debentures lost a rupee to 1,120 rupees on 1,000 units traded and those of Mauritius Leasing Company were down by 8 rupees to 1,042 on 1,508 units.
